visualCharacteristics.purpose: Image-only cards in a 3-column grid of rounded photos
visualCharacteristics.layout: 3-column grid on desktop (2 on tablet, 1 on mobile); a trailing single item spans the full width
visualCharacteristics.description: Rounded photos in a wrapping 3-column grid on a very dark (inverse) section band; a fourth image renders as a full-width wide image below.

contentPattern.structure: one row per item, one image cell (optional second caption cell)
contentPattern.notes: The section heading and 'Field Notes' link are default content above the block; the dark band comes from Section Metadata (style: inverse). When the item count is 4, 7, 10, ... the last item spans the full row.

usage.description: In the Field section on the WKND Adventures homepage.

reuseGuidance: Use for photo galleries or image grids with no per-item text. For cards with text use a text-bearing cards variant.
